## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      8 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 12 sept 2026 - 20 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Amy H_, 19 sept 2026, 1/5: "DO NOT USE THIS APP. I canceled before my trial ended and I still got charged.very hard to get ahold of and when I did they basically said sorry!!! Don't waste your money!!"
            2. _Tessa Wilde_, 20 sept 2026, 4/5: "amazing app!! I would have given 5 stars, but I'm unable to continue app due to price is way too high."
            3. _DeOsha Ann_, 19 sept 2026, 4/5: "I love the everyday workouts 💪 I just wish the BetterMe Tracker wasn't so expensive, I'd buy it. Customer service is very good with their response times and are very helpful."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 may 2026 - 15 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Bonolo Rambau_, 15 sept 2026, 1/5: "the app glitches, i can't even access my meal plan. I have been a member for less than an hour"
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 may 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23 jul 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
